Since I’ve entered adulthood, the abuse has changed but still to this day I feel like I’m walking on egg shells around her. Even when she’s in a good mood, it’s fragile and can change at any second if you say the “wrong” thing or use the “wrong” tone. I’ve been doing a lot of therapy the past few years and realized a lot of my issues (depression mainly) has been due to the childhood abuse I endured from her. I’m open to your constructive judgments.
